'''Ferbils''' were small furry creatures found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. They were often domesticated.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Ferbils made chirping sounds when they were nervous, and the creatures could eat seeds for sustenance.<ref name="The Fight for Truth" />
